prompt: Create a complex, professional, publication-ready vector flowchart explaining a Genetic Algorithm optimization workflow. White background, landscape composition, crisp thin dark-navy connectors with directional arrowheads, modern flat technical infographic style, blue/teal/violet/orange accent colors, ample whitespace, highly legible English sans-serif labels. Structure: Start -> Define objective function and constraints -> Encode candidate chromosome -> Initialize diverse population -> Evaluate fitness. Then a decision diamond labeled "Termination criterion met?". If Yes: Select best solution -> Validate constraints -> End. If No: Selection (tournament + elitism) -> Crossover -> Mutation -> Repair infeasible offspring -> Evaluate offspring fitness -> Replacement / next generation -> loop back to the termination decision. Include a side feedback branch from fitness evaluation labeled "Diversity monitor" feeding into an "Adaptive mutation rate" module, then into Mutation. Add a small bottom legend for chromosome, population, fitness, and elite archive. Use concise exact labels only; no paragraphs, no logos, no watermark, no decorative illustrations.
